modes.name: colour24
modes.experimental_note: 3 passes F1d7 -> MA (SKn) -> MB (KSn) on set 7: pure S/K net-0 colour passes (n 1-20, code 4 holds), about 25 s; 64 distinct colours at dE00 5 (30 at 8) vs 6 stock, camera-provisional, band > 24.5 C only; the 0xB0 holds a 24-entry maximin palette (closest pair 8.5) in 3-bit codes

modes.name: partial_bw
modes.experimental_note: BW2_kick3_w10 plus a held-K top-up: full-window flashing partial, 0 = to K, 1 = to W, 2 = unchanged K (W 4 | K 4, net 0, ends on K), 3 hold. Without the top-up held K fades a step per update from the rail-up/reset before the first command. 3.2 s per update; counter 00-10 on OD6FACF2 with K held, judged by eye, not measured [1 ex, prov]

modes.name: full_quick
modes.experimental_note: stock waveform at fixed PLL 07: 9.2 s, ~8 % chroma loss (R-0046)

modes.name: partial_bw
modes.experimental_note: BW2_kick3_w10 (B4 N0) full-window partial: 0 = to K, 1 = to W, 2/3 hold; product cycle K 3.1 / W 2.9 dE00 at 100 updates (R-0237, R-0238) [1 ex]; through the firmware, counter 00-10 holds K on ODBDD245 and OD6A1908 at 20-29 C; OD18FCAA, after a 64-state colour16 sweep, fades held K a step per update (panel history, not the data) [2 ex + 1 outlier, prov]

modes.name: colour32

modes.name: colour20
modes.experimental_note: 20 colours in 2 passes, G13 -> PS_best_A on set 4, about 27 s; 29 distinct at dE00 5 (19 at 8) vs 6 stock, camera-provisional; 0xB0 = 20-entry maximin palette in 3-bit codes (R-0244)
